fields.name: New
fields.description: Initial case state before assignment occurs.

fields.name: Triage
fields.description: Validity analysis and determination. Triage occurs once the case is assigned to a coordination team. Validation of the case is determined in this step. If the case is deemed not valid it will be closed. If validation is confirmed, this case moves to the next state.

fields.name: Outreach
fields.description: Initial contact with vendor. Vendor is contacted by assigned team or researcher and requested to review the case and comment in VINCE-NT. Outreach time requirement is dictated by criticality level and future SOP/policy.

fields.name: Unresponsive Vendor
fields.description:
Vendor does not respond to initial contact.
After a pre-determined amount of time, a case will move to this section when a vendor does not respond. When a coordinator attempts additional contact, this case will automatically move back to the ‘Outreach’ bucket.After 45 days from initial outreach attempt this case is flagged as overdue and marked red. This may be adjusted once vendor response is received

fields.name: Case Discussion
fields.description:
Vendor accesses VINCE-NT and interacts with the case.  
This case is marked yellow after 14 days of no interaction from vendor and/or researcher.
This case is marked red after 30 days of no interaction from vendor and/or researcher.
This case is moved to the unresponsive bucket if there is no vendor and/or researcher action after 45 days.

fields.name: Vendor Remediation
fields.description: Vendor has patch or mitigation plan in place or vendor is actively working to implement mitigation or patch. Once vendor has patch or mitigation plan in place this will move to advisory development. After a predetermined amount of time of no interaction, this will move to unresponsive vendor.

fields.name: Advisory Development
fields.description: Development lifecycle of an advisory. This includes multiple substates.

fields.name: Coordinator Development
fields.description: Coordination team creates initial publication. Coordinator solicits input from researcher and/or vendor for initial draft.

fields.name: Vendor Review
fields.description: Vendor reviews draft of publication and provides their input/feedback.

fields.name: Researcher Review
fields.description: Researcher/Reporter reviews draft of publication and provides their input/feedback.

fields.name: Final Draft
fields.description: Advisory is edited based on feedback and approved by all parties.

fields.name: Publications Review
fields.description: Final technical review of publication performed by lead coordination team. Awaiting established publication date.

fields.name: Published
fields.description: Advisory approved for publication, and published.

fields.name: Closed
fields.description:
Final case note added and case is closed. 
If new information becomes available in the future, this case can be referenced in a new entry. Email notification of case closure are disseminated to all involved parties.

fields.name: CVEs Published
fields.description: Any applicable CVEs have been published to CVE Services.
